items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Martin was playing guitar. Saik was playing drums. Oh yeah, good lineup. He had a good lineup. I met all them fellas

ctx.x: He tried to do, make his son, put his son down on the trumpet, put him down in the band. But boy wouldn't do right. He wouldn't make good. He never did make good. He played, but he never did make good. He had to give it up. Yeah. But he kept him right there on the bandstand with him, playing with all good musicians. Cherie was playing clarinet, sax, Adolf Alexander was playing clarinet, sax. Martin was playing guitar. Saik was playing drums. Oh yeah, good lineup. He had a good lineup.
